metadata.title: Odd-Degree Rigidity and a Numerical Characterization of Complete Flag Varieties
metadata.abstract: Let $F=G/B$ be the complete flag variety of a connected semisimple complex linear algebraic group. We prove that if a smooth Fano variety $X$ has the same dimension and Picard number as $F$, then the existence of a continuous map $X\to F$ of odd topological degree implies $X$ is isomorphic to $F$. In particular, a smooth Fano variety homotopy equivalent to $F$ is isomorphic to $F$. The algebraic input is a numerical characterization of complete flags: a positive-dimensional smooth Fano variety $X$ is a complete flag variety if and only if its pseudoindex $\iota_X$ is at least two and ${\rm ker}({\rm Sym}^2N^1(X)_{\mathbb R}\to N^2(X)_{\mathbb R})$ contains a positive-definite quadratic form. The pseudoindex condition can equivalently be replaced by the divisibility of $-K_X$ by two in ${\rm Pic}(X)$. The key observation is that a single definite quadratic relation excludes surfaces in every fiber of any elementary contraction; standard contraction theorems then yield smooth ${\mathbb P}^1$-fibrations and the characterization of complete flags applies. For the odd-degree theorem, Poincaré duality and a mod-two Wu-class argument show that the anticanonical class is divisible by two; comparison of the integral coroot lattices then identifies the flag. Most proofs were developed through extensive discussions with OpenAI's ChatGPT (GPT-5.6 Sol and GPT-6), based on mathematical directions supplied by the author and arguments suggested by ChatGPT; see the AI Disclosure.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 在复数域上，完全旗 F=G/B 的 G 连通半单。Theorem1.1：光滑 Fano 簇 X 若与 F 同复维、同 Picard 数，存在任意连续奇拓扑次数映射 X→F 即得 X≅F；映射本身不必代数，也不声称该连续映射就是同构。Theorem1.2：正维光滑 Fano X 为完全旗，当且仅当伪指标ι_X≥2且 ker(Sym²N¹(X)_R→N²(X)_R) 含正定二次型；也等价于把ι_X条件替换为 −K_X∈2Pic(X)，保留同一正定核条件。正定性是对曲线数值空间 N₁(X)_R 上的二次型而言，不能误写为每个交数均为正。
techniques: 正定二次关系在收缩纤维曲面上给0>0矛盾，迫纤维维数≤1
极端射线长度≥2配合收缩定理得到光滑P¹纤维化，再调用既有完全旗识别
奇次数与Poincaré对偶给Picard格奇指数嵌入；Wu公式和Steenrod自然性导出w₂(X)=0
上交数多项式的Weyl分解恢复余根直线与反射配置
整余根格模二剩余类计数区分B_m/C_m，排除仅有理超平面配置无法分辨的类型
analysis.breakthrough: 给出单个正定数值关系驱动的完全旗识别，进一步把奇次数连续映射变成复代数簇类型的刚性。
analysis.limitations: 已读 PDF 第1–16页相关定义、Theorems1.1/1.2、收缩与奇次数路线及余根格步骤，渲染第2页核对三个等价条件；未独立验证整篇证明及引用的收缩/旗识别定理。奇次数包括负奇数；同维、相同Picard数与光滑Fano都须保留。伪指标≥2与−K二可除不在任意Fano上无条件等价，只在本刻画与正定关系合取时可替换。该结论不声称 f 必为同构：P¹ 的三次自映射即反例；有限代数映射同构推论额外排除P¹因子。
analysis.aiEvidence: 摘要和第15–16页披露大多数证明经与 GPT-5.6 Sol/GPT-6 长期讨论形成，模型建议中间命题、证明路径和数学论证，并协助审查修订证明、文献检索、核查参考文献及稿件准备。原始 mixed-intersection 与 Dynkin 图恢复的问题明确源于作者先前研究；披露未把某一个具体核心构造或步骤单独归因模型，保守记 proofs/exploration 等，不据泛称路径建议标 ideas。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.41237v1 · PDF 第 1 页摘要与第 15–16 页 AI Disclosure
